en.headline: Standard Chartered Hong Kong Marathon 2027 public ballot opens
en.dek: Public registration for the January 17 race began at 2pm on Friday, with total main-event places raised to a record 78,000.
body: Public ballot registration for the Standard Chartered Hong Kong Marathon 2027 opened at 2pm on Friday and runs until 7pm on 20 September.

Organisers said the main race on 17 January will offer a record 78,000 places across the full marathon, half-marathon and 10km events. Local entry fees are HK$600 for the full marathon, HK$520 for the half and HK$420 for the 10km. First-round ballot results are due on 25 September.

A new 5km waterfront run at Kai Tak is scheduled for the previous day, 16 January, with 3,000 places. The Hong Kong Amateur Athletic Association is handling entries through the official marathon website.

zh.headline: 渣打香港馬拉松2027公眾抽籤報名今午開始
zh.dek: 主賽事總名額增至歷來最高的78,000個，公眾報名今日下午2時起至9月20日晚上7時截止。
body: 渣打香港馬拉松2027公眾抽籤報名今日下午2時正式開始，截止日期為9月20日晚上7時。
大會表示，明年1月17日主賽事總名額增至歷來最高的78,000個，包括全馬、半馬及10公里。本地參賽者報名費分別為全馬600元、半馬520元及10公里420元。第一輪抽籤結果將於9月25日下午2時公布。
賽會亦新增於1月16日在啟德舉行的五公里海濱跑，名額3,000個。報名詳情及連結已於渣打香港馬拉松官方網站公布。
